policy.description: Promote source-explicit actor, timing, output, evidence and verification semantics into machine-readable metadata without inventing audit artefacts or generic controls not required by the Act.
rules: Preserve existing staged metadata unless an override below supplies a more explicit source-derived value.
Do not populate evidence_expectation merely because evidence would be useful to an auditor; populate it only where the legal proposition itself requires or necessarily produces assessable material.
Do not populate required_artefacts for system capabilities unless the provision expressly requires a document, log, record, form or other output.
Where timing is expressly stated in the provision, represent it in timing_or_frequency even if the same timing appears in requirement_summary or lifecycle_stage.
Where a qualification or exception is source-express, keep it in applicability_conditions or exceptions_or_qualifications rather than burying it in prose.

required_artefacts: Access documentation for access to special-category personal data processed under Article 4a(1)
evidence_expectation: Documented access to the special-category personal data together with the applicable access-control safeguards.
Documented risk management system for the high-risk AI system.

timing_or_frequency: Define the applicable metrics and probabilistic thresholds before the testing in which they are used.
evidence_expectation: Prior-defined testing metrics and probabilistic thresholds appropriate to the intended purpose.
Technical documentation drawn up before market placement or putting into service.
Current technical documentation reflecting applicable updates.
Technical documentation that demonstrates Section 2 compliance and provides competent authorities and notified bodies with the information necessary to assess compliance.
Technical documentation containing at least the elements specified in Annex IV.

timing_or_frequency: For each use of an Annex III point 1(a) high-risk AI system.
evidence_expectation: Automatically generated logs containing the start date/time and end date/time of each use.
Automatically generated logs identifying the reference database against which input data was checked.
Automatically generated logs containing the input data for which the search produced a match.
Automatically generated logs identifying the natural persons involved in verification under Article 14(5).
Instructions for use supplied with the high-risk AI system in an appropriate digital format or otherwise and meeting the Article 13(2) quality criteria.

timing_or_frequency: Effective human oversight must be possible during the period in which the high-risk AI system is in use.
Identify and, where technically feasible, build the provider-side oversight measures before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service.
Identify deployer-implemented oversight measures before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service.
Separate verification and confirmation must occur before a deployer action or decision is taken on the basis of the system identification.
verification_method: Separate verification and confirmation by at least two natural persons with the necessary competence, training and authority, unless the stated disproportionality exception applies.

evidence_expectation: Instructions for use declaring the levels of accuracy and the relevant accuracy metrics of the high-risk AI system.

timing_or_frequency: Applies while the high-risk AI system continues learning after market placement or putting into service.
